description: SP ENW - Operational Data - Live Customers Off Supply is a dataset listed in Electricity North West open data portal, an open data portal of an electricity distribution network operator, published or maintained by Electricity North West. Dataset Classification - Open SP ENW - Operational Data - Live Customers Off Supply Tabular dataset, summarising all SP ENW customers indicated as off-supply. Table is automatically updated, with new values logged on every 15 minute interval. Coverage: Great Britain (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Operational Data. Its keywords are Domestic Customer Persona, Off Supply. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-enw-open-data-portal.
